description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git bugreport' command. It contains a series of test cases that verify the behavior of generating bug reports, checking report content, handling errors, and inspecting diagnostic outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the enclosed command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or text streams, succeeding if they are identical.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in the output or file.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Defines cleanup commands to run after test execution.

methods.name: nongit
methods.description: Runs a command outside of a git repository context.

methods.name: $GIT_UNZIP
methods.description: Utility for unzipping archives, used to test contents inside zip files.
